==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=DocNet&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/DocNetTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=DocNet&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.DocNet: Renders a pdf to a png per page, with the text of each page as a metadata snapshot, using pdfium.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.DocNet
// Note: pdfium renders slightly differently on each operating system, so
// VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng(0.95) is the recommended comparison for these snapshots.
// Note: The rendering is done by native pdfium binaries that arrive with the package, one per
// runtime identifier.
// Note: PagesToInclude(count) and SkipPdfNormalization() exist but are not in the readme; toggling
// normalization rewrites existing verified pdfs once.
// Note: With a second pdf extension referenced, PagesToInclude and SkipPdfNormalization are
// ambiguous at compile time and have to be called in their static form.
// Note: The samples need a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
public class DocNetTests
{
    // A pdf becomes a png per page plus a metadata snapshot with the page count and the text of
    // each page, so a wording change and a layout change show up as different files.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task Pdf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf");
    }

    // Rendering one page of a long document keeps a test fast and its diff small. The index is
    // zero based, and the metadata still reports the full page count.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task FirstPage()
    {
        var stream = File.OpenRead("sample.pdf");
        return Verify(stream, "pdf")
            .SinglePage(0);
    }

    // The render size is fixed here rather than taken from the page, which is what makes the png
    // comparable between machines with different defaults.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task PageDimensions()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf")
            .PageDimensions(new(1080, 1920));
    }

    // The alpha channel is kept instead of being flattened onto white, for a document meant to
    // be drawn over something else.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task PreserveTransparency()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf")
            .PreserveTransparency();
    }
}
